title: Python timed task: masjid library
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y11 lesson 37 (Pupil PDF worksheet: masjid library practical brief and mark scheme)
intro: Lesson 37. A mock practical: read the brief, plan, then code. The library is fictional.

blocks.text: A masjid library stores its books in books.csv: title, author, borrowed (yes or no), due date (YYYY-MM-DD, blank if on the shelf). Write a menu program: 1 list all books; 2 search by title (any part, any capitals); 3 list books due back before a date the user enters; 4 quit. Validate menu choices and dates. When option 3 runs, also write the overdue books to overdue.csv.

head: Requirement
Marks
rows: Menu loops until quit; invalid choices rejected with a message
Reads the file into a suitable structure
Search matches part of a title, ignoring capitals
Lists books due before the date; writes overdue.csv
Readable code and a test log

blocks.text: Entering 2027-02-05 for option 3 should list 'Stories of the Prophets' and 'Riyad as-Salihin' (dates in YYYY-MM-DD order can be compared as text).
